# Photivra Nope Camera

> A free, open-source (GPL-3.0-only) camera app for iPhone and iPad, with Android planned. It captures a photo with as little processing as the device allows, can sign it with C2PA Content Credentials (off by default), and saves it to Photos. It makes no network calls, has no analytics, and removes private metadata by default. Status: in development (0.x).

The rules for contributors and coding agents are in AGENTS.md. Read it before changing anything.

## Project rules

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical rules for coding agents and contributors (evidence, full test coverage, honesty, no network, code style, documentation)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): pull requests, sign-off, contributor license agreement
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting and scope

## Code and documentation

- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, import rules and data flow
- [docs/BUILDING-AN-INTERFACE.md](docs/BUILDING-AN-INTERFACE.md): how to replace the SwiftUI interface
- [docs/TESTING.md](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the checks, unit tests, UI tests and documentation build; CI jobs
- [docs/PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md): what the app writes and removes, and the metadata plan
- [docs/design/README.md](docs/design/README.md): the design set for release 1.0.0 (direction B, Reach): every screen as an HTML mockup with a PNG, for iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Apple Watch, and the index of the files below
- [docs/design/overview.html](docs/design/overview.html): entry page of the design set, with the decisions made and what is beyond interface work
- [docs/design/BUILD-SPEC.md](docs/design/BUILD-SPEC.md): build specification: component trees mapped to Swift files, acceptance criteria, new strings, work chunks
- [docs/design/tokens.md](docs/design/tokens.md): design tokens (spacing, radii, sizes, type, color, materials, motion, button types) named as Swift constants
- [docs/design/ACCESSIBILITY.md](docs/design/ACCESSIBILITY.md): accessibility and Siri specification for each screen
- [docs/design/navigation.md](docs/design/navigation.md): every option, the path to it and tap counts before and after
- [docs/design/photo-details.html](docs/design/photo-details.html): the What's in This Photo sheet (Photo Details): its groups, what is behind disclosure rows, and where each value comes from
- [docs/design/assistant-access.md](docs/design/assistant-access.md): the Assistant Access design, proposed 2026-11-18 (issue 82): the setting for Siri, Shortcuts and other assistants, the check and the question, what an assistant can read, devices, accessibility, tests and the decisions
- [docs/design/level-haptic.md](docs/design/level-haptic.md): the level haptic design, accepted 2026-11-18: when the tap plays and when it is held back, the feedback, wording, devices, accessibility and tests
- [docs/design/SETTINGS-PLAN.md](docs/design/SETTINGS-PLAN.md): the Settings review and its twelve decisions, accepted 2026-11-17; the record behind the Settings structure and the device coverage
- [docs/design/layouts.html](docs/design/layouts.html): the rule that gives each window its layout, and which screens are drawn for iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Apple Watch
- [docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md](docs/SECURITY_AUDIT.md): threat model, every pre-release security check with how to run it and pass criteria, and the sign-off checklist

## Store and privacy policy (drafts, need human review)

- [docs/store/README.md](docs/store/README.md): App Store listing drafts, field limits, and the features each claim depends on
- [store/metadata/README.md](store/metadata/README.md): App Store listing text (name, subtitle, promotional text, description, keywords) in English (`en-US`), one file per field, and its review status
- [docs/store/app-privacy-label.md](docs/store/app-privacy-label.md): App Store privacy label answers ("Data Not Collected")
- [docs/store/accessibility-label.md](docs/store/accessibility-label.md): Accessibility Nutrition Label answers and the evidence each needs
- [docs/store/privacy-policy-draft.md](docs/store/privacy-policy-draft.md): privacy policy draft, for the maintainer to publish

## API (generated from DocC comments)

- [docs/api/NopeCore.md](docs/api/NopeCore.md): state, intents, capabilities, the capture backend protocol, settings, the metadata allowlist, read-back and save pipeline (the interface contract)
- [docs/api/NopeCapture.md](docs/api/NopeCapture.md): AVFoundation and PhotoKit adapters
- [docs/api/NopeDevelop.md](docs/api/NopeDevelop.md): RAW development, encoding settings and the ImageIO read-back
- [docs/api/NopeSigning.md](docs/api/NopeSigning.md): C2PA Content Credentials with a new key for every file, offline
- [docs/api/NopeUI.md](docs/api/NopeUI.md): the SwiftUI interface

## Research

- [docs/research/c2pa-signing.md](docs/research/c2pa-signing.md): offline, per-photo C2PA signing with Secure Enclave keys
- [c2pa-lib/README.md](c2pa-lib/README.md): the C2PA library built from source with no networking code, and how it is checked
- [docs/research/capability-survey.md](docs/research/capability-survey.md): iPhone and iPad camera capabilities and the v1.0 plan
- [docs/research/capture-and-file-settings.md](docs/research/capture-and-file-settings.md): every capture and file setting AVFoundation and ImageIO let an app control, and which ones the app offers
- [docs/research/privacy-claims.md](docs/research/privacy-claims.md): every privacy statement, its verified wording and its sources
